project_type: Monorepo: React 19 + TS SPA (Vite 8) frontend, AWS Lambda (TS ESM) backend, AWS CDK (TS) infra. Not under git version control — do NOT run git commands.
language: TypeScript (ESM throughout; backend relative imports MUST use .js extension)
build_system: Three independent packages (frontend/, backend/, infra/), each with its own package.json. Run npm install inside each package separately — there is no workspace-level package manager.
test_framework: Vitest + React Testing Library + vitest-axe (frontend a11y) + fast-check (property tests). CDK tests use aws-cdk-lib/assertions (Template.hasResourceProperties) with __snapshots__.
build_command: frontend: npm run build (tsc + vite build). infra: npx cdk synth. backend: no bundler build; vitest compiles.
test_command: backend: cd backend && npx vitest --run | frontend: cd frontend && npx vitest --run && npm run build && npm run lint | infra: cd infra && npx vitest --run && npx cdk synth
verification_instructions: After backend changes: cd backend && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run. After frontend changes: cd frontend && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run && npm run build && npm run lint. After infra changes: cd infra && npm install (first time) && npx vitest --run && npx cdk synth. Co-locate unit/property tests next to source; vitest-axe toHaveNoViolations() in every frontend component test; property tests use { numRuns: 100 } with describe title referencing feature+property number and docstring referencing the validated requirement.
snapshot_or_generated_files: infra/test/__snapshots__/ holds CDK template snapshots (api-stack, cdn-stack, foundation-stack). If an api-stack snapshot assertion changes, update it with npx vitest --run -u in infra. No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Repo is NOT a git repository: never run git/branch/commit/push. Region is ap-northeast-1 (not relevant to unit tests). Backend/service error messages are Japanese by existing convention; frontend converts AppError to Japanese for display.
contribution_requirements: Strict Handler → Service → Repository layering: handlers never call repositories/docClient directly (exception: pre-existing post-session-aggregate.ts and post-consensus-resolve.ts call docClient directly — do NOT add NEW direct docClient calls; using an existing repository function like getSessionById is allowed). Use AppError factories (validationError 400 / notFoundError 404 / forbiddenError 403 / internalError 500) — never throw raw errors. Named exports only, no default exports. JSDoc above each handler (METHOD /path + summary). Flat frontend components/ dir (no subdirectories). Frontend service funcs return Result<T, AppError>.
key_patterns: Backend reopen mirrors post-session-aggregate.ts (requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER') + isAdmin branch + !assignedTeamId→forbiddenError + isTeamMember + recordAuditLog). updateSessionStatus(sessionId, status) updates ONLY status+updatedAt on SESSION#{id}/METADATA (never CONSENSUS#*/SEGMENT#*), so policy A holds automatically. VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS.COMPLETED=[] so reopen must NOT route through changeSessionStatus. ReviewPage uses single switches editingEnabled=Boolean(onSaveCorrection) and suggestionEnabled=Boolean(onFetchSuggestions); gating them + onRevert disables all edit UI while TranscriptionDownload (guarded only by transcriptionApi && sessionId && sessionName) stays enabled. ReviewPageWrapper already fetches getSessionDetail (session includes status) — no new fetch needed. SessionAggregateControls.tsx + aggregate-error.ts + forceAggregateSession are the exact mirrors for the new reopen UI/util/service.
relevant_files: backend/src/services/correction-service.ts (createCorrection — add guard before try; already imports addParticipant from session-repository.js)
backend/src/services/session-service.ts (addSpeakerLabel/deleteSpeakerLabel add guard; add reopenSession; VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS; assignSession is the permission-pattern mirror)
backend/src/services/audit-service.ts (re-exports audit type; recordAuditLog generates logId+createdAt)
infra/test/api-stack.test.ts (route assertions via hasResourceProperties AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route RouteKey)
frontend/src/App.tsx (ReviewPageWrapper status propagation; SessionListPageWrapper renderSessionActions + handleReopen wiring; canManage already computed)
